card.fires_on: Partway through an unfamiliar proper name, such as an African ethnic group or person, a foreign name, or a new brand drug name, split into pieces. The marked piece is a short syllable in the middle of the name.

modes.label: Foreign personal and group names
modes.description: A middle syllable inside a rare person, place or ethnic group name.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: A middle syllable inside a newly coined brand drug name.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of an odd, rarely seen name that the model has to read in pieces.
